steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art game VFX sprite sheet. The attached image is the LEVEL-2 version of a skill effect sheet of Hỏa Quy (fire). Redraw it as the LEVEL-3 (mythic tier) version, FRAME FOR FRAME: exactly the same grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, the same order, every frame shows the same moment as the attached frame in the same cell, facing right, same pixel art style with a dark outline. Canvas square 1:1. Flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). Each effect stays inside its own cell and must not touch its neighbours. Level-3 rules: one tier ABOVE the attached level 2, a MYTHIC, god-tier move: keep everything level 2 has (thick lightning, shockwaves) and add a GLOWING MAGIC RUNE CIRCLE / SEAL, a translucent SPIRIT-BEAST silhouette of the creature made of energy, and pillars of light; the effect fills more of its cell than level 2 but still ENDS inside the cell with a clear magenta gap on every side, never cut by the cell border. Big bold shapes, thick outlines, flat colour blocks, high contrast, no tiny particle noise. Keep the red, orange, yellow colours with white-hot cores and golden flame tips, plus a new deep violet-black core shadow and white-gold divine light so it clearly reads as a higher tier than level 2. This sheet: skill 2 (main skill) - Shell Roll: the rolling shell is wrapped in a blazing phoenix-fire comet with a long trail of golden runes, the impact erupts into a lava dome with a ring of fire pillars. LAYOUT OF THIS ONE IMAGE: rows alternate. Odd rows (1, 3, 5...) are the level-3 frames: row 1 = row 1 of the attached sheet, row 3 = its row 2, frame for frame, same order. Each EVEN row, right under a frame row, holds the IN-BETWEEN frames for smoother animation: the cell under a frame is the moment exactly HALFWAY between that frame and the NEXT frame, a new drawing halfway in size, position and lightning shape, not a copy. Row 1 loops: cells 1-3 = halfway from frame n to n+1, cell 4 = halfway from frame 4 back to frame 1. Row 2 plays once: cells 5-7 = halfway from frame n to n+1, cell 8 = frame 8 fading out a bit further. All cells the same size, every effect fully inside its own cell with a magenta gap, same place in its cell as the frame above it.
